summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for homepage-first entry, world simplification, navigation, communities directory/feed APIs, and responsive behavior. Pytest suite passed 41/41 including new cross-community feed tests; critical UI flows passed on desktop and required mobile widths.
action_items: No blocking defects found in this scope.
Optional: ignore automation-overlay net::ERR_ABORTED console noise in preview runs; not an app runtime defect.
Optional: avoid frequent ReadPixels probes in future automated checks to reduce WebGL GPU-stall warning noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend social directory/feed responses remain typed and exclude MongoDB _id in tested responses.
Community feed mutation flows (like/repost/delete) are consistent and pagination/cursor behavior is stable under test data cleanup.
World page implementation matches simplified scope: interactive map/buildings/search/controls only; removed legacy intro/selector marketing elements.
seed_data_creation: Created only ephemeral TEST_* social posts during API tests; removed associated likes/reposts/feed/activity rows after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated root stays homepage, desktop/mobile 5-destination nav, world controls/canvas/building click routing, community directory/feed route behavior (?view=feed history), docs desktop chapter buttons + mobile select, and pending social links disabled with Soon labels. Wallet chooser (Phantom/Solflare) modal verified; full wallet connect/disconnect social UI mutations were not executed in browser due no injected extension wallet in this environment.
rca of the issue: No product defects confirmed in this run. One initial automation attempt falsely reported no canvas animation because sampling method used a too-stable pixel signature; a second full-frame dataURL pixel-motion check confirmed canvas changes and control-driven frame changes.
